After stirring for 5 min at -78 °C, trifluoromethanesulfonic anhydride (8.8 mL, 52.5 mmol, 1.05 equiv.) was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred for 1 h at that temperature before being quenched by water (100 mL). reference: Synthesis and applications of β-aminoethanesulfonyl azides | Brouwer, Arwin J.; Merkx, Remco; Dabrowska, Katarzyna; Rijkers, Dirk T. S.; Liskamp, Rob M. J. | Synthesis (2006), (3), 455-460
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Sulfonyl Azides 2a-f; General Procedure A solution of NaN3 (195 mg, 3.00 mmol) in H2O (10 mL) was added dropwise to a solution of the sulfonyl chloride 4a-f (3 mmol) in acetone (15 mL) and DMF (15 mL). The reaction was stirred at r.t. for up to 1 h. After evaporation of acetone, H2O (200 mL) was added and the product precipitated. The mixture was filtered and the residue was washed with 5% NaHCO3 soln (10 mL), H2O (50 mL), and dried in vacuo. Sulfonyl azides 2a-f were all obtained as white solids. 2c (Derived from Fmoc-valine)17 Scale: 1.1 mmol; yield: 0.36 g (79%). Rf = 0.54 (MeOH-CH2Cl2, 1:99); mp 158 °C. IR (KBr): 2139 (s) cm-1. 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl3): δ = 0.96 [2 d, 6 H, CH(CH3)2], 2.04 [m, 1 H, CH(CH3)2], 3.49 (dd, 1 H, CHaSO2, Jgem = 14.7 Hz, Jvic = 3.7 Hz), 3.60 (dd, 1 H, CHbSO2, Jgem = 14.7 Hz, Jvic = 8.1 Hz), 4.01 (m, 1 H, NCH), 4.22 [t, 1 H, CH (Fmoc)], 4.45 [m, 2 H, CH2 (Fmoc)], 5.04 (d, 1 H, NH), 7.29-7.77 [m, 8 H, Ar-CH (Fmoc)]. 13C NMR (75 MHz, CDCl3): δ = 18.1, 19.2 [CH(CH3)2], 31.5 [CH(CH3)2], 47.2 [CH (Fmoc)], 53.0 (NCH), 57.0 (CH2SO2), 66.9 [CH2 (Fmoc)], 119.0, 125.0, 127.1, 127.7, 141.3, 143.6, 143.7 [Ar-C (Fmoc)], 155.7 [C=O (Fmoc)]. ESI-MS: m/z (%) = 415 [M + H]+, 437 [M + Na]+, 453 [M + K]+. Anal. Calcd for C20H22N4O4S: C, 57.96; H, 5.35; N, 13.52. Found: C, 57.77; H, 5.28; N, 13.39.

experimental_procedure: N -Benzyl-N’-(2-methyl-allyl-phenyl)-sulfamide (7). A solution of 2-Aminobenzylalcohol (3.86 g, 0.031 mol, 1 equiv) and pyridine (3 mL, 0.038 mol, 1.2 equiv) in 100 mL of CH2Cl2 was cooled to 0 °C and treated with benzylaminesulfonyl chloride (6.4 g, 0.031 mol, 0.99 equiv) in 20 mL of CH2Cl2. After being stirred 12 h at 23 °C, the volatiles were removed in vacuo. The crude product was dissolved in EtOAc (100 mL) and washed with saturated aqueous (20 mL). The aqueous layer was extracted with EtOAc (2x100 mL) and the combined organic layers dried over Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated in vacuo. The crude oil was purified by flash chromatography on SiO2 (30–40% EtOAc/hexane eluent), providing 3.9 g of sulfamide 20 as a white solid (43% yield). Data for (2-sulfamido benzylalcohol 20): mp 79-81 °C; 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3) δ 7.86 (s, 1 H), 7.55 (d, J = 8.0 Hz, 1 H), 7.33 (dd, J = 7.6, 8.0 Hz, 1 H), 7.25 (m, 3 H), 7.16 (m, 2 H), 7.08 (t, J = 7.3, Hz, 1 H), 4.83 (s, 1 H), 4.66 (s, 2 H), 4.25 (d, J = 5.8 Hz, 2 H), 1.95 (bs, 1 H); 13C NMR (75.45 MHz) δ 136.9, 136.2, 129.3, 129.2, 128.9, 128.6, 127.89, 127.86, 124.2, 120.3, 64.0, 47.4; IR (neat, thin film) 3307, 3056, 2926, 1603, 1589, 1497, 1455, 1418, 1330, 1265, 1153, 1060, 1003, 934 cm-1; HRMS (EI) calcd for [M]+ C14H16N2O3S1: 292.0876, found 292.08646.
